Global (All).title: China Sees Widespread Protests Over COVID Lockdowns, Zero-COVID Policies
Global (All).summary: Protests erupted in multiple Chinese cities as people took to the streets to express their discontent with the government's COVID-19 lockdown policies, resulting in clashes with police and widespread arrests.

Global (All).title: Iran Cracks Down on Protests, Arrests Hundreds of Anti-Government Demonstrators
Global (All).summary: Iranian security forces arrested hundreds of protesters and activists as they cracked down on anti-government demonstrations across the country, sparking international condemnation.

Global (All).title: US-Russia Relations Hit New Low as Russia Expels American Diplomats
Global (All).summary: Russia expelled several American diplomats in retaliation for the US expelling Russian diplomats, further deteriorating relations between the two countries and exacerbating global tensions.

South Korea.title: North Korea fires two ballistic missiles in apparent provocation as US and South Korea conduct large-scale military drills
South Korea.summary: North Korea conducted two ballistic missile tests on Monday, which landed in the Yellow Sea. The launches were seen as an apparent response to the US and South Korea's ongoing large-scale military drills in South Korea.

South Korea.title: South Korea's ruling party proposes military reform to address North Korea threat
South Korea.summary: South Korea's ruling party has proposed a comprehensive military reform to strengthen the country's defense system in response to North Korea's growing military threats.

South Korea.title: Activists call for investigation into alleged North Korean hacking of South Korean online gaming platform
South Korea.summary: A group of South Korean activists has demanded an investigation into allegations of North Korea's involvement in the hacking of a popular online gaming platform in South Korea.
